ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Utinni — Inhabited (Ash'karr)
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The Junkers pilot settlement manifest for SETTLEMENT_VISIT_LOOP_1, naming an actual Ash'karr settlement: The Claim Jump (Jawa_Junkers, tile 16905, ZBiome_Badlands — squatting the worked-out mining fields the Geonosians did not finish; design/Jawa/worldbuilding/ASHKARR_WORLD_DEFINITION.md §7 / world/ASHKARR_WORLDMAP_settlements.csv row 44). Low security, forgiving, per the spec's "Junkers pilot: low security, forgiving": the security profile here waves leavers through.
Data only — districts, cast slots and the security profile are schema instances of `mandrake.rm.inhabited`'s SettlementManifestDef/SecurityProfileDef. No district art (DISTRICT_TEMPLATE_LIBRARY_1), no verb tuning (SETTLEMENT_VERBS_WAVE_1), no claim math (RM_Property, untouched).
